indicator_evidence_stack.findings: Price structure, volume behavior, and key Wyckoff events.
indicator_evidence_stack.trade_impact: This is mandatory and has priority over all indicators.

indicator_evidence_stack.source: Native Volume Profile / custom Pine table / OHLCV binned fallback
indicator_evidence_stack.findings: VPOC, VAH, VAL, HVN, LVN, or exact reason they are unavailable.
indicator_evidence_stack.trade_impact: Missing value evidence usually blocks clean-trade language.

indicator_evidence_stack.source: Anchored VWAP from markdown high, terminal low, spring, UTAD, SOS, or gap anchor
indicator_evidence_stack.findings: Anchor date/price, current AVWAP position, trapped buyer/seller read.
indicator_evidence_stack.trade_impact: Supports or weakens acceptance, LPS/BUEC, and UTAD/LPSY calls.

indicator_evidence_stack.source: Ratio or comparison versus asset-class benchmark set
indicator_evidence_stack.findings: Leadership, laggard behavior, divergence, or benchmark conflict.
indicator_evidence_stack.trade_impact: Weak or missing RS lowers confidence in institutional sponsorship.

indicator_evidence_stack.source: Weis Wave Volume indicator or manual OHLCV wave table
indicator_evidence_stack.findings: Last 3-5 meaningful waves with effort/result conclusions.

indicator_evidence_stack.source: MACD, Awesome Oscillator, or price/spread slope fallback
indicator_evidence_stack.findings: Divergence or no divergence. Do not use crossovers as Wyckoff triggers.
indicator_evidence_stack.trade_impact: Warning evidence only, never standalone entry permission.

indicator_evidence_stack.source: Footprint, CVD, delta, open interest, funding, liquidation map, or volume/spread proxy
indicator_evidence_stack.findings: Absorption plus initiative behavior at a pre-defined key zone, or why it was skipped.
indicator_evidence_stack.trade_impact: Required only when giving lower-timeframe execution or precise entries.

analysis_checklist.evidence: Market read sourced from TradingView MCP only unless explicit external context was requested.
Asset class, session model, benchmark set, and volume reliability were defined.
Each timeframe was fitted or visible range was explicitly set before interpretation.
Price structure and volume were read before secondary indicators.
Native profile was attempted; fallback or missing state recorded.
AVWAP anchors were selected, read, computed, or marked unavailable.
Benchmark comparison was read, computed, or marked unavailable.
Weis Wave or manual wave effort/result table covers the latest 3-5 waves.
MACD/AO/divergence was used only as secondary SOT evidence.
Order flow was required only if execution entries/stops were requested.
Every proposed Wyckoff event has requirement, observed evidence, missing evidence, status, and trade impact.
Every trigger level has explicit acceptance and failure behavior.
Location, trigger, invalidation, reward, and timeframe alignment were scored.
Strongest countercase and proof needed were written before final posture.
journal.md screenshots and evidence.json screenshots reference the same package-relative files.
Clean-trade language was blocked unless the evidence contract allowed it.
